title: openrouter.decisions.error.v1
description: Verified error body shape from POST https://openrouter.ai/api/alpha/decisions on non-200 status, per docs/PI/pi_jev_m0_provider_protocol_de.md section 1. Empirically observed for empty-body validation failure and invalid-model-id cases (both plain-string error.message, one happening to contain JSON-formatted validation detail as text). 401/429/5xx bodies for this specific endpoint were NOT empirically captured (no invalid key / rate-limit trigger used) -- assumed to follow the same {error:{message,code}} envelope pending real verification (section 6).

message.description: Always a string. May itself be JSON-formatted text (e.g. a stringified Zod validation-error array) -- a second JSON.parse is optional for structured field references, never required for basic error handling.

user_id.description: OpenRouter account id echoed back; present on observed error responses, not part of the documented contract -- do not rely on it.
